verdicts.reason: Both break the schedule apart. Only the 02 Dec row stays readable, and it sits at the top beside the legal line. The other rows are scattered as microscopic fragments around the CTA, the logo is shrunk into the bottom-left corner, and the WINTER PROGRAMME kicker is gone. A jams its CTA right under 'studios' and beside the Bookbinding fragment; B gives the CTA more room under the headline but insets the image off the headline's left edge, so B is only marginally less cramped.
